name: android_dump_hierarchy
description: Dumps the raw active window UI accessibility hierarchy XML (classes, resource IDs, text, bounds, clickable).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

compressed.description: Whether to compress layout containers (default true). Set to false to dump full uncompressed Compose/Flutter trees.
